    verify = t2.value32(v85.remainingSeconds, v85.isLifetime)

    local encrypted = v85.encrypted
    if encrypted then
        encrypted = v85.payload

        if encrypted then
            encrypted = v85.nonce
        end
    end

        executePayload = t2.value25(v85.payload, v85.nonce, p18)
    elseif v85.executePayload then
        executePayload = v85.executePayload
    end

        encrypted = #executePayload > 0
    else
        encrypted = executePayload
    end
    if not encrypted then
        if not (t2.value5 and writefile) then
            return true, "Access verified successfully.", verify, v85.isLifetime, v85.remainingSeconds
        end

        pcall(function()
            if not makefolder then
                writefile(t2.value14, p18)

                return
            end

            local isfolder_ = isfolder

            if isfolder_ then
                isfolder_ = not isfolder(t2.value12)
            end

            if isfolder_ then
                isfolder_ = function()
                    makefolder(t2.value12)
                end
                pcall(isfolder_)
            elseif not isfolder then
                pcall(function()
                    makefolder(t2.value12)
                end)
            end

                isfolder_ = not isfolder(t2.value13)
            end

                isfolder_ = function()
                    makefolder(t2.value13)
                end
                pcall(isfolder_)

                    writefile(t2.value14, p18)

                    return
                end

                    makefolder(t2.value13)
                end
                pcall(isfolder_)
            end

            writefile(t2.value14, p18)
        end)

        return true, "Access verified successfully.", verify, v85.isLifetime, v85.remainingSeconds
    end

    pcall(function()
        if not collectgarbage then
            return
        end

        collectgarbage("collect")
    end)
    if not executePayload then
        return false, "Payload syntax error: " .. tostring(encrypted)
    end

        t2.value28 = true

    end

            end

            end
